question: On WebArena-Verified v2 36 families >=3 (192 tasks, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479) with matched task families controlling novelty fraction n in {0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} (train on pool A, test on never-observed B, family-specific slots ${sku},${store_id},${variant},${category}), and genuine kernel resolve/bind/verify with behavioral freshness gating 0.25 and UNKNOWN<0.80 abstention (ECE<=0.15, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, non-vacuous false_accept, no bijective cost formula), does SPIDER parameterized inheritance achieve rho_novelty>=0.60, R2_delta>=0.50, |rho_length|per_stratum<0.20 and honest amortized saving >=25% vs COLD and <=0.85x vs RAG with parity (<=1.20x) at n=0 to shipped Stagehand DOM-hash HIT cache (2000 nodes, 1280x720) and TERX 50-token replay and RAG-EMBED under QCR protocol (frozen bank, same ranker, vary only post-retrieval support) with family-stratified bootstrap (5000) + block permutation (5000), and report tokens/browser/latency/retrieval/verification Pareto vs gpt-4o-mini+Playwright Docker replication?
hypothesis: Later-agent cost under SPIDER parameterized inheritance (family-specific slot induction via src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized with Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor + structure-similarity>=0.75 + field-path relevance body.*|headers.*|url, behavioral freshness probe Flask JWT HS256 0.8 on 401/403 vs 0 on 200 gating 0.25, confidence softmax temp 0.15 + uniform jitter [-0.05,0.05] UNKNOWN<0.80 with ECE<=0.15, verify+repair 500 tok+2 browser calls on fail, fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN) tracks residual novelty fraction n (train A, test B) with Spearman rho_novelty>=0.60 (block-permutation p<0.01, family-stratified bootstrap 5000 CI lower>0.35, slope>0 p<0.01) and R2_delta=R2_novelty-R2_length>=0.50 (R2_novelty>=0.30) while per-hit step cost vs full task length within each novelty stratum is flat (|rho_length|per_stratum|<0.20). At n=0 honest saving >=25% vs B-COLD amortized at f=10 (and sensitivity at f=100) with parity to shipped caches on per-hit cost (SPIDER/STAGEHAND per_hit <=1.20, SPIDER/RAG per_hit <=0.85 at n=0 and n=0.25, SPIDER/TERX per_hit <1.0 at n>=0.25 via QCR). At n=1 UNKNOWN fallback keeps total cost <=1.10x COLD with false_accept<=0.10, UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15 non-vacuously (mock can emit wrong-bound failures).
falsifier: FALSIFIED if controls PASS (PC1/PC2 non-degenerate) but any of: (F1) rho_novelty<0.35 or block-permutation p>=0.05 or R2_delta<0.15 (fails Director threshold 0.50 for SURVIVES); (F2) R2_novelty<=0.30 or per-hit |rho_length|>=0.35 in any stratum (strict <0.20 for SURVIVES, >=0.35 triggers FALSIFIED; 0.20-0.35 is MIXED zone); (F3) amortized total M_total_f10 SPIDER/COLD at n=0 >0.75 (saving<25%) AND M_total_f100 also >0.75 (both f=10 and f=100 fail) — if f=10 fails but f=100 passes, outcome is MIXED not FALSIFIED; (F4) false_accept>0.10 or UNKNOWN_precision<0.85 or ECE>0.15 on verification-derived execution rows (non-vacuous); (F5) SPIDER per_hit not cheaper than B-RAG-EMBED at n=0 AND n=0.25 (ratio>0.85) nor parity to B-STAGEHAND-CACHE at n=0 (per_hit >1.20) nor cheaper than B-TERX-REPLAY at any n>=0.25 (per_hit >=1.0) under QCR honest accounting. MIXED if C1/C2/C3 pass but C4 or C5a economics fails due to constant overhead dominance (correct novelty tracking but no honest total saving). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC1/PC2 fail, bijective formula detected, registry never consulted, UNKNOWN never exercised, baselines starved (hit_rate 0 at n=0 inside compared set), confidence std<=0.05 degenerate ECE, or NC1 shows rho>=0.35 significant (novelty confounded with difficulty).

baselines.description: Cold start: no SPIDER memory. Deterministic proxy cost 500 tok +2 browser calls per novel step, 50 tok+120ms verify per step if Playwright; no retrieval. Paired on identical 192-task family-stratified splits at each n. Denominator for f=10 and f=100 saving. Expected flat vs novelty (|rho|~0) at ~L*unitCost. Success baseline 1.0 via deterministic mock (success discriminated via cost, not rate).
baselines.expected: Cost_total flat vs n (|rho|~0) at ~L*500+retrieval. Per_hit flat ~500. Used as denominator for saving ratios.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instruction baseline: family template prompt (no retrieval/reconstruction) with same proxy budget/tools as SPIDER. Cost = 200 tok instruction amortized f=10->20 (f=100->2) + full identifier-specific steps (500 tok per novel step). Same 192 splits.
baselines.expected: Slightly below COLD but near full length, not novelty-proportional. Beaten by SPIDER >=15% per_hit at low novelty.

baselines.description: RAG semantic retrieval over prior A under QCR protocol: frozen bank of 36 families' A demos, same ranker for all systems (TFIDF Jaccard fallback TAU 0.30 or all-MiniLM-L6-v2 if offline), top-1 verbatim bind with verify fallback to COLD on miss. Retrieval cost 200 tok+150ms. Honestly retrievable at n=0 (overlap 1.0 by construction), proportionally retrievable at n=0.25 (partial overlap = realized novelty). Post-retrieval support is verbatim bind only — no parameterization. QCR varies only post-retrieval.
baselines.expected: Hit cost ~795 tok at n=0 near SPIDER; at n>=0.25 worse than SPIDER (no parameterization). SPIDER per_hit beats >=15% at n=0 and n=0.25 (ratio<=0.85).

baselines.description: Stagehand DOM-hash serverCache: exact-selector + DOM-hash (2000 nodes, 1280x720 viewport CDP AX tree hash) with structural validation. Hit iff DOM identical (n=0 exact repeat, 36 tasks). On aliasing drift miss->COLD. Honest hit cost 50 tok+120ms +1 browser call (~30% COLD). Spec-mandated 50 tok hit, not 400. Measured on same splits, same ranker bank as QCR (retrieval not used for Stagehand Hit logic).
baselines.expected: Hit_rate 1.0 at n=0 -> ~595 tok total (50/L per step). 0 at n>=0.25. At mixed aliasing expected miss where SPIDER parameterized binding succeeds. SPIDER per_hit parity <=1.20x at n=0 allowed; SPIDER cheaper per_hit at n>=0.25.

baselines.description: TERX/BrowserBash 0-token exact replay+LLM fallback under QCR: if test identifier sequence exactly equals training trajectory (n=0 exact repeat) replay at 0 LLM step tokens+50 tok verify+1 browser call ~90-120ms; else fallback to COLD (500 tok per step). Honest 50 tok verify, not 400. Hit_rate by construction 1.0 at n=0, 0 at n>=0.25 inside compared set. Same 192 splits.
baselines.expected: At n=0 ~50 tok verify << SPIDER total but per_hit parity allows <=1.20x total vs per_hit nuance; at n>=0.25 miss->COLD. SPIDER per_hit cheaper at n>=0.25 (<1.0 vs TERX fallback).

baselines.description: PRODUCT SUT: SPIDER parameterized inheritance via src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized (family-specific Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor, field-path-relevant, structure-similarity>=0.75) + behavioral freshness gating 0.25 (Flask JWT mock 0.8 on 401/403 vs 0 on 200) + confidence softmax temp0.15+jitter UNKNOWN<0.80 (ECE 5-bin std>0.05) + verify+repair (500 tok+2 calls on fail) fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN. Registry MechanismRegistry, _bind, amortized distill 1000/f only SPIDER. Genuine branch-derived cost sum of executed retrieval/verify/exec/repair, not bijective formula. Non-deterministic MockEnv can emit wrong-bound failures with p=0.15 when shuffled/random binding attempted, enabling non-vacuous false_accept. QCR frozen bank, same ranker. Reports both M_total_f10/f100 and M_per_hit.
baselines.expected: At n=0 success>=0.85 reused>=0.85 cost_per_hit ~retrieval-excluded parity to Stagehand/TERX, total saving >=25% vs COLD at f=10 or f=100. At n=1 UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 cost_total<=1.10xCOLD false_accept<=0.10. rho>=0.60 R2_delta>=0.50 per_hit |rho_length|<0.20.

positive_control.description: PC1 Exact-repeat cache: B-TERX-REPLAY and B-STAGEHAND-CACHE at n=0 exact-repeat (test seq equals training trajectory) must achieve hit_rate 1.0 inside compared set, 50 tok verify-only per_hit, success 1.0, proving substrate can measure 0-cost case and n=0 not starved. PC2 Parameterized binding on seen ids: SPIDER distill_parameterized trained on 5 obs per family on A must resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action via actual src/spider/kernel.py _bind on held A at n=0 (5/5 per-family spot-check) binding_correctness 1.0. PC3 Non-vacuous verification: NC2-RANDOM forced-execute wrong-bound mock must yield false_accept in [0.10,0.60] and success<=0.90 proving mock can fail (non-vacuous). Failure of PC1/PC2 ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID; failure of PC3 ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID (vacuous mock not discriminating). PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH not gating (file-based census primary) but if Playwright used report health>=80% AX nodes>10 else exploratory.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1 hit_rate 1.0 cost_per_hit ~50 tok success 1.0. PC2 SPIDER binding 5/5 per family 1.0 at n=0 via _bind. PC3 NC2 false_accept 0.10-0.60 when forced execute. Any PC1/PC2/PC3 failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.

null_control.description: NC1 Shuffled slot mapping: randomly permute learned parameter_slots before SPIDER resolve via actual registry/_bind/verify/mock on same 192 tasks; mock emits wrong-bound failure p=0.15 on shuffled execute, else UNKNOWN fallback. Expect |rho_novelty_per_hit|<0.25 p>=0.05, success<=COLD, false_accept in [0.10,0.60] if forced. NC2 Random mechanism: retrieval returns random registry entry, UNKNOWN enabled with same mock failure rate, expect false_accept>=0.10 or |rho|<0.25 and success<=0.90. NC3 Length-proportional fail-able control: cost_total = L*500 + retrieval miss regardless of novelty; per_hit cost = 500 constant. Expect |rho|<0.25 R2_novelty<0.15 on both total and per_hit proving environment can express MIXED/FALSIFIED. All via actual pipeline, no simulated correctness, non-vacuous mock.
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 |rho|<0.25 n.s., success collapse or false_accept 0.10-0.60. NC2 false_accept>=0.10 or |rho|<0.25. NC3 rho~0 R2~0 on both metrics. If NC1 shows rho>=0.35 significant (block-perm p<0.01) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (novelty confounded with difficulty/single-slot identity artifact).

measurement_validity: 1. Census fidelity: WebArena-Verified v2 192 tasks /36 families >=3 /49 templates /duplication 0.9479/param_task 0.8958. Load /tmp/webarena or repo-cached JSON if present; else generate synthetic family-structured mock replicating exactly 36/49 ratios and log provenance, disclose ceiling as synthetic file-based not Docker/full-DOM (192/36 L 8-14 family-specific slots ${sku},${store_id},${variant},${category} family-specific not generic ['path','store']). Manifest+hashes+seeds logged; intents template-parameterized catalog flows.

2. Controlled novelty hold-out within family under QCR: per-family disjoint A(train)/B(test never-observed) pools zero overlap, frozen bank for all retrievers. Fractions n {0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} realized by sampling test tasks where n fraction of parameterizable slots drawn from B and (1-n) from A stratified by slot position and family. n=0 are exact-repeat sequences so TERX/Stagehand hit_rate 1.0 reachable inside compared set (fixes prior 0/100 starvation). Train 5 demos/family on A only; registry one parameterized mechanism/family via actual distill_parameterized Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor field-path-relevant structure-similarity>=0.75 not hard-coded. All fit (TFIDF/embedding, distill) on TRAIN only. QCR: frozen bank, same ranker (TFIDF Jaccard TAU 0.30 or all-MiniLM-L6-v2), vary only post-retrieval support (verbatim vs parameterized vs DOM-hash vs exact-replay). Realized novelty (round_half_up(n*S)/S) disclosed per task for S=1/2 families where labelled 0.25 realizes as 0.0.

3. Length co-variation disclosure and per-hit isolation: L family-specific 8-14 constant within family varies across families; report per-family L distribution duplication param_task. Novelty n and L orthogonal within strata by design; bootstrap respects family grouping. Primary discriminant for |rho_length| is M_per_hit = (total_cost - retrieval - distill_amort)/L (cost per step excluding fixed overhead) reported per task; secondary M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 for economics. This isolates per-hit step cost from fixed retrieval/distill amortization (f=10 primary, f=100 sensitivity) removing structurally unsatisfiable C4 artifact. No shuffling of tokens within strata to force |rho_length|<0.20 (VF2 forbidden).

4. SPIDER executed not formula-defined with non-vacuous mock: actual src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized + _extract_varying_values + Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor + structure-similarity>=0.75 field-path relevance + behavioral freshness probe (Flask JWT HS256 0.8 vs 0) gating 0.25 + confidence softmax temp0.15+jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 (std>0.05 ECE 5-bin). At test resolve(intent,context,params) via SpiderKernel.resolve checking required_slots parameter_slots|template_slots, freshness>=0.25->UNKNOWN, confidence<0.80->UNKNOWN, _bind, verify postconditions via observed post_state match, repair 500 tok+2 calls on fail, fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN. Non-deterministic MockEnv: when NC1/NC2 shuffled/random binding attempted, emit wrong-bound action with p=0.15 (seeded) that fails verify -> false_accept>0 non-vacuous; SPIDER correct binding at n=0 verifies pass. Success/false_accept/UNKNOWN/reused are verification-derived with genuine variability so rho can be <1 and MIXED falsifiable. Cost sum of executed branches (retrieval 200 tok+150ms verify50+120ms hit50+1 call novel/failed 500+2 repair 500+2) not 250+500*int(10n) bijective (VF1 forbidden). Distill 1000/f only SPIDER f=10 primary f=100 sensitivity, instruction 200/f. If gpt-4o-mini+Playwright available add real token/browser ±50% proxy sensitivity appendix.

5. Strong baselines identical splits honest accounting retrievable under QCR: all baselines same 192 tasks same proxy/verify fallback to COLD on miss, same frozen bank same ranker. B-RAG-EMBED proportionally retrievable at n=0.25 (partial overlap) not binary n=0-only. B-STAGEHAND-CACHE DOM-hash (2000 nodes 1280x720) logic, B-TERX string equality. Hit cost 50 tok+120ms per spec (not 400, VF6) and RAG retrieval+verify honest. Per-hit cost excludes retrieval/distill for parity tests; total cost includes them for economics. None starved; hit_rate n=0 must be 1.0 inside compared set. Distill only SPIDER; instruction correctly amortized at f=10 and f=100.

6. Calibration/abstention measured not assigned with non-vacuous mock: UNKNOWN_precision=TP_UNKNOWN/(TP+FP_UNKNOWN) where UNKNOWN correct when no applicable mechanism or gated<0.80 and would-verify would fail (mock wrong-bound 15% failure enables discrimination); false_accept=EXECUTABLE wrong binding failing verify on mock's 15% wrong-bound rate. Both verification-derived not hash-assigned. Confidence via softmax+jitter (temp0.15, uniform jitter [-0.05,0.05] seeded) not linear 0.95-n*0.12. ECE 5-bin derived confidence vs correctness (EXECUTABLE rows only for ECE_exec, UNKNOWN quantified via precision), 3 empty bins disclosed, bootstrap 2000 for ECE CI per stratum+pooled, confidence_std>0.05 required. Thresholds false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE<=0.15 verification-derived non-vacuous (PC3 ensures mock can fail).

7. Statistics: primary Spearman rho between per-task M_per_hit and novelty n (and secondary rho_total) family-stratified N~192 block-permutation p primary (family-label permutation 5000) and 5000 family-stratified bootstrap (resample families with replacement then tasks within family) for 95% CI on rho,R2_delta,cost ratios,rho_length respecting dependency. Linear regressions cost~novelty and cost~length per stratum report slope/p/R2 heteroscedasticity-robust SE for both M_per_hit and M_total_f10. Degenerate CI [1,1] flagged degenerate not precision. ANOVA novelty*length if p<0.05 disclose and report within-stratum rho_length on M_per_hit.

8. Holdout contamination: no test B identifier appears in train registry verbatim (verify 0 hit outside controlled n=0 exact repeats); TFIDF/embedding/distill from A only; reconstruction from train only; hidden_expected template not passed except verify after resolve. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected/test B verbatim except params binding. Strict family hold-out train A pool never sees B; leakage assertion B∩evidence empty.

9. Sampling determinism: PYTHONHASHSEED 0 random.seed42 numpy RandomState42 for sampling/jitter/wrong-bound p=0.15/permutation. Each task once per method paired design; bootstrap CIs primary uncertainty not post-hoc jitter inflation. Playwright if used 1280x720 CDP AX tree hash+snapshot deterministic (2000 nodes). No outcome-bearing measurement before freeze. Pareto reporting (DolphinBench style): scatter accuracy vs total cost vs median latency per system/stratum, tokens/browser/latency/retrieval/verification分解.

10. Prereg freeze provenance: prereg.md+spec.json frozen via freeze.json before outcome-bearing measurement; code (kernel distill_parameterized hash, registry.py, models.py, MockEnv non-deterministic branch), fixtures (census manifest hash, family/task JSON hashes, realized_novelty column), thresholds, proxy constants, Playwright version pin, embedding model name, QCR bank hash, decision rule hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV (task_id,family_id,labelled_n,realized_n,novelty_fraction,length,system,success,false_accept,unknown,precision,tokens,browser_calls,latency_ms,retrieval_ms,verification_ms,reused_steps,hit,verify_passed,repair_triggered,confidence,ECE_bin,M_total_f10,M_total_f100,M_per_hit) plus registry JSONL per family, cost_config.json with f=10/f=100 and per_hit formula, branch_traces.json with wrong-bound counts, QCR bank manifest. Provenance run id commits hashes artifact SHA256. Exploratory gpt-4o-mini+Playwright Docker replication (if credentials/network allow) on same 36-family census (15-step budget, temp0 seed42) reports real tokens/browser/latency alongside proxy with correlation rho_proxy_real; if unavailable, disclose as not executed and retain proxy-only conclusion bounded to file-based mock.
decision_rule: All thresholds family-stratified pooled N~192 file-based census primary (proxy branch-derived); gpt-4o-mini+Playwright Docker replication exploratory if available does not gate SURVIVES. Compute per-method success,false_accept,UNKNOWN_precision,ECE 5-bin (EXEC rows), M_total_f10, M_total_f100, M_per_hit per task, Spearman rho_novelty on M_per_hit (primary) and M_total_f10 (secondary), R2_novelty,R2_length per stratum and pooled R2_delta on M_per_hit, rho_length per stratum on M_per_hit, Wilson95% for rates, family-stratified bootstrap5000 for rho/R2/ratio CIs, block-permutation 5000 p for rho. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (C1) correctness+calibration: SPIDER success at n=0 >=0.85 Wilson lower>=0.72 mean success across n bins >=0.80 false_accept<=0.10 overall UNKNOWN_precision>=0.85 ECE_exec<=0.15 (5-bin derived confidence std>0.05, 3 empty bins disclosed, PC3 non-vacuous mock verified) verification-derived; (C2) positive controls: PC1 B-TERX and B-STAGEHAND hit_rate 1.0 at n=0 inside compared set 50 tok verify-only per_hit success 1.0, PC2 SPIDER binding 5/5 per family at n=0 via actual _bind correctness 1.0, PC3 NC2 forced wrong-bound false_accept in [0.10,0.60] proving non-vacuous mock — failure of any PC ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of C3-C6; (C3) novelty tracking: rho_novelty on M_per_hit >=0.60 block-permutation p<0.01 family-stratified bootstrap95% lower>0.35 slope>0 p<0.01; (C4) residual explanatory power: R2_delta on M_per_hit >=0.50 (R2_novelty>=0.30) and each stratum |rho_length| on M_per_hit <0.20 (5 strata, no shuffling, per_hit metric); (C5) work compression honest: (C5-total) SPIDER/COLD on M_total_f10 <=0.75 at n=0 (>=25% saving) OR on M_total_f100 <=0.75 at n=0 (sensitivity — if f=10 fails but f=100 passes, grade MIXED not FALSIFIED; both fail ->FALSIFIED) AND SPIDER/COLD on M_total_f10 <=1.10 at n=1 via UNKNOWN; (C5-perhit) SPIDER/STAGEHAND on M_per_hit <=1.20 at n=0 (parity within 20% shipped cache exact repeat) AND SPIDER/RAG-EMBED on M_per_hit <=0.85 at n=0 AND at n=0.25 (beats RAG via parameterization under QCR) AND SPIDER/TERX on M_per_hit <1.0 at every n>=0.25 (<COLD fallback where SPIDER binds); (C6) null controls: NC1 shuffled on M_per_hit |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 success<=COLD or false_accept in [0.10,0.60], NC2 random false_accept>=0.10 and |rho|<0.35, NC3 B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL on M_per_hit |rho|<0.25 R2_novelty<0.15. Precedence: If C2 fails ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID irrespective of C3-C6. If C2 passes but C3 or C4 fail with C1 pass ->MIXED (correct but per-hit cost flat overhead dominates). If C2 passes but C5-total both f fail or C5-perhit fails ->FALSIFIED (no honest saving or no QCR advantage). If NC1 shows rho>=0.35 significant ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID novelty confounded. Degenerate bootstrap or shuffling manipulation ->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. All thresholds two-sided alpha 0.01 primary, 0.05 secondary. Pareto appendix required but not gating.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES family-stratified on M_per_hit and M_total (either f=10 or f=100): C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL bounded to WebArena-Verified v2 file-based census 192/36 proxy with genuine kernel resolve/bind/verify+freshness 0.25+UNKNOWN<0.80+non-vacuous mock (ECE<=0.15 precision>=0.85 false_accept<=0.10) under QCR (frozen bank same ranker). First non-bijective no-shuffling per-hit-isolated evidence later-agent cost tracks residual novelty (rho>=0.60 R2_delta>=0.50 not length |r|<0.20 per_hit) with honest saving >=25% vs COLD (f=10 or f=100) beating retrievable RAG (<=0.85x per_hit) and parity to shipped Stagehand 2x/30% at exact repeat (<=1.20x per_hit) and beating TERX at >=25% (per_hit <1.0). Unblocks C-PRODUCT-ECON amortized scale-up to Docker full-DOM+real LLM (intel sample-level overlap+runtime replication prerequisites with measured effectSize for f=100 and Pareto tokens/browser/latency reporting) and C-LLM-INHERIT QCR advantage. Justifies parameterized inheritance as commercial lever despite Stagehand dominance at exact repeat via per-hit isolation insight. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion; replication with production Docker hosting+real LLM+kernel-committed distill required before promotion. Report Pareto frontier (accuracy vs total cost vs median latency) and per-hit vs total decomposition.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED (controls PASS non-vacuous but rho<0.35 or R2_delta<0.15 or both f=10 and f=100 saving<25% or not beating Stagehand/RAG/TERX per_hit where they honestly hit under QCR): parameterization as ported does not yield residual-novelty-proportional compression on this WebArena family hold-out aliasing mix, or only via miscalibration, or constant overhead dominates even per_hit (MIXED if rho passes but economics fails). Product must NOT claim pay-cost-of-novelty for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON; keep exact-intent or per-site mapping; prioritize caching (Stagehand 2x already ships) or freshness/delta-repair or semantic-resolve orthogonal before revisiting economics. MIXED directs investigation to retrieval/verification/repair constant dominates not slope vs per_hit isolation failure. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS bounded REJECTED for proxy setting only not global falsification (honest per_hit economics closed for this kernel/cost model/QCR census). No promotion; invest in kernel Jaccard/freshness/UNKNOWN calibration or richer cross-site DOM/QCR post-retrieval before re-testing. Pareto will show where cost accumulates.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate: 192 tasks 36 families x6 conditions SPIDER/COLD/INSTRUCTION/RAG/STAGEHAND/TERX +3 controls ~1728 deterministic resolve/_bind/verify trials plus TFIDF/embedding offline and non-deterministic mock wrong-bound p=0.15 branches. File-based fixtures no Docker required (Docker/Playwright only if gpt-4o-mini steps measured). Wall <40min CPU proxy (<90min if Playwright 2000-node 1280x720); if gpt-4o-mini 15 steps Playwright ~2300 calls <$12. Storage per-task CSV ~1728 rows registry JSONL cost_config traces QCR bank manifest. No LLM keys required for proxy isolation; ~$8-12 if real LLM exploratory.
expected_information_gain: Very high: first per-hit-isolated non-bijective non-starved test of central economic promise after prior FALSIFIED due to structurally unsatisfiable C4 (|rho_length|~1.0) and infeasible C5 (1.50x Stagehand) under total-cost model and vacuous mock (false_accept 0). This design directly fixes the three audit REQUIRED_FIXES: per-hit cost excluding fixed retrieval/distill (f=10/f=100), non-deterministic mock enabling false_accept in [0.10,0.60], and QCR frozen-bank same-ranker protocol with proportional RAG at n=0.25. Either valid positive (rho>=0.60 R2_delta>=0.50 per_hit |r|<0.20 beating shipped Stagehand/TERX/RAG per_hit) or valid negative/MIXED (flat per_hit or no honest saving even at f=100 under QCR) decisively changes product decision: (1) whether C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up to Docker/full-DOM+real LLM justified vs premature, (2) whether parameterized inheritance justifies productization despite exact-repeat cache dominance via per_hit economics, (3) whether residual-novelty holds beyond synthetic L10 mock to WebArena family hold-out with family-stratified CIs and Pareto cost decomposition. Resolves 44-deep frontier tunnel opportunity cost and provides DolphinBench-style Pareto (accuracy+total cost+median latency) for commercial viability.
